▎ Task: finish PR #1351 (issue #1349) — fix the two round-1 review findings, nothing else.
▎
▎ Context: repo seungpyoson/bolt-v2, branch fix/1349-settlement-currency-park, current head f2d1bcb1dd253f9418f635cbf88d820b424347a5, PR https://github.com/seungpyoson/bolt-v2/pull/1351 (draft). The PR fixes the v0.1.11 settlement-park chain: items 1 (capital-pool settlement currency), 2 (boot-time validator), 4 (entry-path log volume) are implemented and reviewer-verified at this head — do not modify them. Item 3 (terminal booking-error release) is implemented but the owner review found two issues. Full review: PR comment 4935595786. Design context for item 3 is in the PR body.
▎
▎ F1 — BLOCKER. apply_settlement_booking_terminal_release (src/strategies/binary_oracle_edge_taker/mod.rs, ~1254) gates the SettlementBookingTerminal lifecycle evidence AND the log::error! behind the process-wide bool settlement_booking_terminal_latched, while the Flat release runs on every call. Second and later terminal booking errors in one process therefore release exposure silently — no evidence, no error line. Fix: dedupe the lifecycle evidence + ERROR per settlement key (mirror the existing booking-error evidence one-shot in the same file); the process-wide latch may remain only as the sticky operator signal. Required differential test: two distinct booking-error keys in one process → two SettlementBookingTerminal evidence records and two releases; it must fail on the current head.
▎
▎ F2 — REQUIRED, choose one lane. settlement_booking_terminal_latched has zero consumers — the operator-health transition promised in the item-3 proposal does not exist. Either (a) wire it into the live operator-health surface as a producer snapshot, but only if a cheap seam exists — do not build new plumbing for this PR; or (b) de-claim: edit the PR body to state plainly that operator visibility for terminal booking errors is the ERROR log line plus durable evidence only, no health-surface transition, follow-up ledgered. State in your report which lane you chose and why.
▎
▎ Gates before pushing: the new F1 differential red-then-green; the booking/validation and entry-skip test sets green; just fmt-check; runtime-literal allowlist updated if any new log/evidence strings. Do not un-draft, do not queue.
▎
▎ Report back: new head SHA, F2 lane chosen, test names + results. The reviewer runs full verification at the new head.

I’m using the review-feedback, systematic-debugging, TDD, GitHub-comment, and verification skills because this is a tightly scoped review fix with an explicitly required red/green differential test. I’ll preserve items 1/2/4, choose the cheapest valid F2 lane after inspecting the existing health seam, and won’t un-draft or queue.

+3. **Terminal booking-error (item 3)** — live + recovery: durable booking-error evidence, per-settlement-key lifecycle `SettlementBookingTerminal` → `Flat` evidence + ERROR, and exposure release (no timers/gates). Operator visibility is the ERROR line plus durable evidence only; this PR does not publish a health-surface transition.
+4. **Log volume** — entry block WARNs state-change-keyed; submit-skip WARNs deduped with `record_entry_skip_once`; unblocked path one INFO on transition + debug full dump; NT order-book OOO module filter to Error.

+**This PR changes `config/root.toml`.** The next deploy must ship **config + on-box regeneration** (`ops generate-live-config` / verify against the profile), **not a binary swap alone**. `config/live.toml` is gitignored and regenerated from root ⊕ overlay.
+
+## Item 3 riders
+**(a) #1276 recovery tests whose expectation flipped Managed → Flat** (with rationale):
+
+| Test | Why Flat |
+|---|---|
+| `position_market_lifecycle_recovered_missing_interval_book_delta_records_error_not_exit` | Terminal booking-error must release single-exposure occupancy; exit still blocked by booking-error key / no exit submit, not by Managed parking. |

▎ PR #1351 final round — five items from the external adjudication (comment 4936092246). No design changes.

CP-1 (blocker): config_parsing::bolt_v3_archetype_keeps_default_provider_market_exit_shape_permissive fails at head — give the fixture a matching non-enforcing capital pool, sweep every other fixture-built root config hosting a binary-oracle strategy for the same shape, and run the FULL suite at the new head (no scope filters).

▎ 3. Boundary pin: add a test asserting every live-entered/pending-adopted position carries interval_end_ms (anchors: runtime_state.rs:235, pending-lifecycle inheritance) — so the unmanageable leg can never silently widen to live positions.
▎ 4. Remove settlement_booking_terminal_latched: it's write-only in production (zero readers). Re-anchor the six test assertions on settlement_booking_terminal_evidence_keys being non-empty.
▎ 5. Body notes: cross-restart duplicate terminal evidence is accepted-by-design (one per key per process lifetime, discriminated by raw_reason_text); deploy wording sharpened — the v0.1.12 binary against the old on-box root.toml refuses to boot by design, so config ships with the binary.

+## Summary
+

+- D4: keys entry-block and submit-skip logs on state/evidence transitions and configures the NT order-book venue-quirk module at Error.
+
+## Terminal-release invariant
+
+Terminal booking-error release applies under a two-leg invariant: **market-expired ∨ position-unmanageable-by-construction**. The second leg is the recovery-only unknown-interval shape: both exit and settlement are permanently blocked, so retaining occupancy would park the strategy forever. Live-entered and pending-adopted positions are pinned to carry `interval_end_ms`; the unmanageable leg must not silently widen to live positions.
+
+## Operator visibility and restart evidence
+
+This slice provides an ERROR line and durable settlement-booking plus `SettlementBookingTerminal` evidence for every distinct settlement key. It does not publish an operator-health transition and has no operator acknowledgement clear path.
+
+Terminal lifecycle evidence dedupe is intentionally process-local. If a residual position remains open across restart, recovery may emit one additional `SettlementBookingTerminal` record and ERROR for that key. This is accepted by design: emission is bounded to one per key per process lifetime, and `raw_reason_text` discriminates the live terminal path from the restart recovery path.
+

+
+- `settlement_currency_for_execution_account` is crate-visible. Production caller: `register_runtime_strategy`. Validation caller: `validate_strategy`.
+- `BoltV3OrderLifecycleTransition::SettlementBookingTerminal` is emitted by `BinaryOracleEdgeTaker::apply_settlement_booking_terminal_release` and persisted through the existing order-lifecycle evidence writer.
